main_body: small round pedestal table with items on top
top_band: elliptical tan/brown tabletop from row 1 to row 9 (9 rows), though separated from the pedestal at row 10 by an empty transparent row
evidence: The elliptical tabletop spans rows 1-9 (9 rows tall) with two items placed on it, and a central pedestal base spans rows 11-15 (5 rows tall), though row 10 is inexplicably a 1px transparent gap between top and base. Despite the floating gap, both the foreshortened horizontal top surface and the vertical pedestal support below it are clearly drawn in 3/4 view.

style.evidence: The wood ramp uses about 4 brown tones plus white/tan for the small objects on top, with dark brown outlining on the tabletop and pure black outlining/shadowing on the pedestal and book. The broken 1px gap at row 10 and heavy black blocks on the base make it read slightly rough compared to the reference props, though colour density for a single 16x16 tile is decent.
